```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggdag)
library(dagitty)

# Create a DAG showing the relationship between fouls and defensive impact
dag <- dagify(
  shot_prob ~ defender_ability + offense_quality,
  defender_ability ~ defensive_skill + defensive_pressure,
  defensive_pressure ~ physical_attributes + fouls,  # More fouls reduce defensive pressure
  fouls ~ defensive_pressure,  # More pressure leads to more fouls
  outcome = "shot_prob",
  exposure = "fouls",
  labels = c(
    "shot_prob" = "Shot Making\nProbability",
    "defender_ability" = "Defender\nAbility",
    "offense_quality" = "Offense\nQuality",
    "defensive_skill" = "Defensive\nSkill",
    "defensive_pressure" = "Defensive\nPressure",
    "physical_attributes" = "Physical\nAttributes",
    "fouls" = "Accumulated\nFouls"
  )
)

# Plot the DAG with improved readability
ggdag(dag, layout = "fr") +
  theme_dag() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    text = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  geom_dag_node(size = 20) +
  geom_dag_edges(edge_width = 1) +
  geom_dag_label_repel(aes(label = label)) +
  labs(title = "DAG of Fouls and Defensive Impact on Shot Making")
```

```{r}
dag_2 <- dagify(
  shot_prob ~ defender_ability + offense_quality,
  defender_ability ~ defensive_skill + defensive_pressure,
  defender_ability ~ teammate_ability,
  defensive_pressure ~ physical_attributes + fouls,  # More fouls reduce defensive pressure
  fouls ~ defensive_pressure,  # More pressure leads to more fouls
  outcome = "shot_prob",
  exposure = "fouls",
  labels = c(
    "shot_prob" = "Shot Making\nProbability",
    "defender_ability" = "Defender\nAbility",
    "offense_quality" = "Offense\nQuality",
    "defensive_skill" = "Defensive\nSkill",
    "defensive_pressure" = "Defensive\nPressure",
    "physical_attributes" = "Physical\nAttributes",
    "teammate_ability" = "Teammate\nAbility",
    "fouls" = "Accumulated\nFouls"
  )
)

# Plot dag_2 with improved readability
ggdag(dag_2, layout = "fr") +
  theme_dag() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    text = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  geom_dag_node(
    aes(color = ifelse(
      name %in% c("fouls", "shot_prob", "physical_attributes", "position", "teammate_ability"),
      "Observed",
      "Unobserved"
    )),
    size = 25
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(
    palette = "Set1",
    name = "Variable Type"
  ) +
  geom_dag_edges(edge_width = 1.2) +
  geom_dag_text(
    aes(label = label),
    size = 4,
    color = "white",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "DAG of Fouls and Defensive Impact on Shot Making",
    subtitle = "Including Teammate Ability"
  )
```

```{r}
dag_3 <- dagify(
  shot_prob ~ defender_ability + offense_quality,
  offense_quality ~ offensive_team + shot_action + shot_zone,
  shot_zone ~ shot_area + shot_distance_ft,
  
  defender_ability ~ defensive_skill + defensive_pressure,
  defender_ability ~ teammate_ability,
  
  defensive_pressure ~ physical_attributes + fouls,  # More fouls reduce defensive pressure
  position ~ physical_attributes,
  fouls ~ defensive_pressure,  # More pressure leads to more fouls
  
  outcome = "shot_prob",
  exposure = "fouls",
  labels = c(
    "shot_prob" = "Shot Making\nProbability",
    "offensive_team" = "Opposing\nOffense",
    "shot_action" = "Shot\nType",
    "shot_zone" = "General Shot\nLocation",
    "shot_area" = "Shot\nLocation",
    "shot_distance_ft" = "Basket\nDistance",
    "defender_ability" = "Defender\nAbility",
    "offense_quality" = "Offense\nQuality",
    "defensive_skill" = "Defensive\nSkill",
    "defensive_pressure" = "Defensive\nPressure",
    "physical_attributes" = "Physical\nAttributes",
    "position" = "Position",
    "teammate_ability" = "Teammate\nAbility",
    "fouls" = "Accumulated\nFouls"
  )
)

# Plot dag_3 with improved readability and visual hierarchy
ggdag(dag_3, layout = "fr") +
  theme_dag() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    text = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  geom_dag_node(
    aes(
      color = ifelse(
        name %in% c(
          "fouls", "shot_prob", "physical_attributes", "position", 
          "offensive_team", "shot_action", "shot_zone",
          "shot_area", "shot_distance_ft"
        ),
        "Observed",
        "Unobserved"
      )
    ),
    size = 25
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(
    palette = "Set1",
    name = "Variable Type"
  ) +
  geom_dag_edges(edge_width = 1.2) +
  geom_dag_label_repel(
    aes(label = label),
    size = 2,
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "DAG of Fouls and Defensive Impact on Shot Making",
    subtitle = "Including Shot Context and Teammate Ability"
  )
```
